_readme: Rosetta dictionary of the scanned set DE-1 (PDF2BIM_VECTOR_PROBE.md §50): values read ONCE from the scan by a multimodal read, owner-accepted 2026-11-24 ('Yes, record it as the dictionary entry and build'), the precedent of §16 (TB-LKTN). Every number below is a pixel measurement of the drawn lines (rows / columns cited) or the printed label; each is checked by type_expect.py before use. Frame: the reference (OG) plan, mm from the house's outer NW corner, y down (sheet).
